title: Unified title
summary: A mouse with a partly human brain offers potential advancements in treating neurological diseases, while AI-driven experiments and genomic research explore new ways to address biological challenges and Parkinson’s disease.

facts.statement: Researchers have developed a mouse with a partly human brain, offering potential advancements in treating neurological conditions. The mouse's brain structure provides insights into how to develop new drugs for neurological illnesses.
Google DeepMind's AI tool could help unravel the mysteries of the human genome and transform our understanding of biology.
Anthropic's AI and biology lab in the San Francisco Bay Area highlights cybersecurity concerns and ethical debates about AI addressing biological challenges.

sources.title: Spider snooze stages
sources.description:

sources.title: Tracing the spread of Celtic languages using ancient genomics
sources.description:
Nature, Published online: 04 November 2026; doi:10.1038/s41586-026-11198-9

Genome-wide data from 4,587 ancient individuals are analysed, focusing on Bronze and Iron Age Europe, to test the extent to which alternative archaeological and linguistic models for the origin and spread of Celtic fit reconstructed demographic histories.
